# Local notation dependencies

- VexFlow 4.2.5: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vexflow@4.2.5/build/cjs/vexflow.js`, MIT (VEXFLOW-LICENSE).
- jsPDF 4.2.1: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf@4.2.1/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js`, MIT (JSPDF-LICENSE).

Pinned, locally served browser bundles. VexFlow 4 includes its engraving font outlines and does not require a runtime font CDN. Loaded only when staff notation / PDF export is used. No remote content or user uploads are sent to these projects. PDF uses 2x rasterized SVG pages for consistent Chinese titles and music glyphs. SVG export preserves vectors.
